Class JobImpl

  • java.lang.Object

      • discard

        public void discard()
        Discards this job: removes it from the SDK's active-job registry without sending any log message to the nJAMS server.

        Use this to release an abandoned job whose final outcome will never arrive (e.g. a tracking session evicted on an idle timeout), so that the SDK frees the memory it holds for the job instead of keeping it alive for periodic flushing and the final flush on Njams.stop(). Any data recorded so far is dropped and is never reported.

        After discard() the job is treated as finished: Job.isFinished() returns true, and further operations on it behave as they would on an ended job. Discarding a job that has already ended or already been discarded is a no-op. Discarding an unfinished job logs a warning, because data recorded for the job is not reported to the server.

        Specified by:
        discard in interface Job
        See Also:
        Job.end(boolean)
